source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 785 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 785 was established by Ordinance No. 27193, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 28, 2008. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 785 is established on property generally located west of Caruth Haven Lane and north of the terminus of Cornerstone Parkway. The size of PD 785 is approximately 4.88 acres. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 785A: development plan. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 785A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The following uses are the only main uses permitted:

-- Cemetery. [Limited to 1,000 square feet.] -- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [See Section 51A-4.209(3.1).] -- Local utilities. -- Office. -- Single family. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) For a single family use or handicapped group dwelling unit use, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) For all other uses, the following yard, lot, and space regulations apply:

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 25 feet.

(2) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(3) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area is 14,000 square feet.

(4) Height.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, maximum structure height is 25 feet.

(B) For Building A, as shown on the development plan, maximum structure height is 35 feet.

(C) Ornamental cupolas, domes, or clerestories may exceed the maximum height by five feet.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is eight percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(6) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(7) Stories.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, maximum number of stories above grade is one.

(B) For Building A, as shown on the development plan, maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off-street parking and loading must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Access And Visibility Obstruction
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.111. ACCESS AND VISIBILITY OBSTRUCTION.

(a) Except as provided in this section, nonemergency vehicular ingress and egress to or from the Property must be from Caruth Haven Lane as shown on the development plan.

(b) Vehicular ingress or egress to or from the Property onto Cornerstone Parkway is limited to emergency vehicles.

(c) If a fire department emergency access box is provided, a visibility triangle is not required at Cornerstone Parkway. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) In the area surrounding the existing statue, as shown on the development plan, trees removed to preserve the historical integrity of Building A are not required to be mitigated.

(d) For the purposes of Article X, the garden area shown on the development plan is a design standard. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) For non-residential uses, garbage collection may only occur between 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 27193)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-785.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 785 is located on Zoning Map No. G-8. (Ord. 27193)
